title: ScreenShare Helper
description: A lightweight Minecraft screenshare plugin that freezes players, restricts actions, and guides them through a Discord screenshare process for staff investigations.
body:
# Vanilla Screenshare

Vanilla Screenshare is a lightweight moderation plugin for Minecraft servers that allows staff members to freeze players, restrict gameplay actions, and guide them through a Discord screenshare process.

## Features

* Freeze players during investigations
* Prevent movement while screenshared
* Disable block breaking and block placing
* Disable inventory interaction
* Prevent item dropping
* Restrict command usage while screenshared
* Automatic Discord join reminders
* Staff notifications for screenshare events
* Detect players who disconnect during a screenshare
* View all active screenshares
* Lightweight and easy to configure

## Commands

```text
/screenshare <player>
/ss <player>

/screenshare stop <player>

/screenshare list

/screenshare stopall
```

## Permission

```text
screenshare.use
```

## Configuration

```yaml
discord-url: "https://discord.gg/yourserver"
discord-display: "discord.gg/yourserver"
message-interval-seconds: 5
```

## How It Works

When a player is screenshared, they are frozen and repeatedly instructed to join your Discord server. During this time they cannot interact with the world, move freely, or perform restricted actions. Staff members receive notifications when a screenshare starts, ends, or if a player disconnects during the process.

## Use Cases

* Practice Servers
* PvP Servers
* SMP Servers
* Competitive Communities
* Staff Teams Performing Cheat Investigations

## Why Vanilla Screenshare?

Vanilla Screenshare focuses on simplicity, reliability, and ease of use. There are no unnecessary features or complicated setup processes. Install the plugin, configure your Discord invite, and start conducting screenshares immediately.

Built for modern Minecraft moderation.
